_note: HAND-AUTHORED (Director's wizard skill tree, 3D side; not exported from the 2D game). Same shape as data/talents.lua LADDER[class]: choices[] each with level and options[]. An option has either `ability` (a key of `abilities` below: a spell the hero gains) or `trait`/`mods`. Empty tiers are the design's blank slots (to be defined). [tuned] marks numbers the design did not give.

rules.fire: Fire damage applies BURN: a damage over time of 15% of the damage dealt, spread over 5 s.
rules.frost: Frost applies FROST: the target takes extra damage (frostVulnerability) and is slowed (frostSlow) for 5 s.

options.name: Pyromancer
options.desc: Blizzard turns into Firestorm and Ice Block turns into Hellfire. Burning deals double damage.

options.name: Cryomancer
options.desc: Explosion turns into Ice Shock and your auto attacks turn into frost bolts.

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.desc: Deal 250% damage to enemies in an area. Counts as fire damage.

ice_shock.name: Ice Shock
ice_shock.desc: Cryomancer's Explosion: the same blast as frost damage.

iridescent_bolt.name: Iridescent Bolt
iridescent_bolt.desc: A purple fireball: 500% damage to the target enemy. Counts as fire damage.

ice_block.name: Ice Block
ice_block.desc: Invulnerable to all damage for 10 s; every 2 s a wave of frost (the Explosion's area) slows enemies and staggers them for 50% of your attack power. (Stagger is not ported yet: the wave slows and chills only.)

hellfire.name: Hellfire
hellfire.desc: Pyromancer's Ice Block: invulnerable for 10 s while waves of fire ignite enemies around you. [tuned] each wave burns for 50% of your attack power.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.desc: Teleport instantly to the chosen spot. A lightning strike hits an area (the Explosion's) at the start and at the end and stuns enemies for 1 s.

mirror_image.name: Mirror Image
mirror_image.desc: A bright blue copy of you stands diagonally to your lower right and performs auto attacks on your target. Visual only: it is not a unit, it shares your stats and mirrors no abilities.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.desc: An area twice the Explosion's where ice shards rain on enemies for 5 s: 5 ticks, one per second. [tuned] 2 bars, 30 s, 60% damage per tick.

firestorm.name: Firestorm
firestorm.desc: Pyromancer's Blizzard: the same storm of fire (each tick burns).
